name: Higher Resolution Miscellaneous Pack
description: Higher resolution textures for everything the other packs forget: cut-scene props, bowling and billiards, litter, newspapers and cans, interior fittings, the sky dome and the binoculars. By Ash735.

sources.note: Fetched from this project's Dropbox mirror. If that fails it has to be supplied by hand: published only on https://www.nexusmods.com/gta4/mods/357, and Nexus hands out links that expire with a session. Drop it into the working directory exactly as it comes - the name above is the one Nexus gives version 3.1. It carries a file the author named 'weapons_HQspec -deleteifyouhaveweaponmods.img': keep it unless a weapon mod is installed as well.
